testing_and_qa_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, stage indicators, metrics, and modals MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT delete or modify existing backend setup unless required; implement full interactive React frontend with localStorage persistence for challenges and submissions.
2. Use Outfit for headings and Inter for body text; load Google Fonts in public/index.html.
3. Apply the exact deep medical teal (#005F73 / #0A9396), navy (#0A192F), off-white (#F8FAFC), mint (#E6F4F1), and amber (#EE9B00) palette.
4. Ensure all 5 main features (Submission, AI Analysis Panel, University Matching, MedTech Industry Collab, Visual Lifecycle Timeline) are prominent and interactive.
5. Include the main demo example: 'Affordable anemia screening for pregnant women in rural Jharkhand' pre-loaded as the featured challenge.
6. Mark all invented metrics in the Ministry Dashboard with a distinct 'Demo Data' badge.
7. Include the exact AI disclaimer text: 'AI-assisted analysis, not medical diagnosis' inside the AI Problem Analysis panel.
8. Use Sonner toasts for user actions (Submitting challenge, expressing university interest, offering industry support, advancing lifecycle stage).
9. Add data-testid attributes to all key components as listed in data_testid_rules.
